task.title: Searching the Red Hat Knowledgebase
task.shortdesc: To find solutions for Red Hat Quay issues, you can search the Red Hat Knowledgebase. Log in to the Customer Portal, enter keywords related to your problem, and apply the Red Hat Quay and Knowledgebase filters.

ul.li: You have a Red Hat Customer Portal account.

step.cmd: Log in to the Red Hat Customer Portal.
In the main Red Hat Customer Portal search field, input keywords and strings relating to the problem, including:

ul.li: Red Hat Quay components (such as database)
Warnings, error messages, and other outputs related to explicit failures

step.cmd: Select the Red Hat Quay product filter.
Select the Knowledgebase content type filter.
